senses.gloss: (b. h.; ch. דְּכַר) [to mark,] to remember, mention; to celebrate (by a ceremony &c.).
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 106a:5">Pes. 106ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 20:8">Ex. XX, 8</cite> <cite ref="G00447"><he>זכור</he></cite>) <he>זָכְרֵהוּ על היין</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>זוֹכְרֵהוּ</he>) remember the Sabbath (distinguish it) by a benediction over wine; <cite ref="Beitzah 15b:4">Bets. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>זכרהו מֵאַחֵר שבא וכ׳</he> mark the Sabbath (by a ceremony) from another (Holy Day) which (preceding the Sabbath) may cause the neglect of it (Ms. M. <he>לאחר</he>, Rashi <he>מֵאַחַר</he>, v. <cite ref="A01046"><he>אַחַר</he></cite>; v. R. Nissim a. l.).
Men. 43ᵇ ראה … וזְכוֹר וכ׳ see this ceremony and be reminded of another &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. זָכוּר, f. זְכוּרָה
<cite ref="Shabbat 115a:7">Sabb. 115ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ אני ב־</he> I recollect about &c.—
senses.label: a

units: B. Mets. 11ᵃ ז׳ ולבסוף שכוח if the sheaf had been thought of and was afterwards forgotten.—ז׳ לטוב (abbr. ז״ל) remembered for blessing.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> end <he>אליהו ז״ל</he> El. of blessed memory, v. <cite ref="G00470"><he>זִכָּרוֹן</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 13b:8">Sabb. 13ᵇ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="B01299"><he>בְּרַם</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זְכוּרִים</he>.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 13:1">Pesik. R. s. 13</cite>, end; a. e.
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Pesachim 66a">Pes. 66ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 82a:2">Snh. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>ראה מעשה ונ׳ הלכה</he> he saw the practice and recalled the tradition.
<cite ref="Yoma 38a:6">Yoma 38ᵃ</cite> <he>כביד אבותי נִזְכַּרְתִּי</he> I was thinking of the vanished glory of my ancestors.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 45:1">Ex. R. s. 45</cite> <he>הִזָּכֵר</he> remember; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cause to be remembered, to recall.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 55a">Ber. 55ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ג׳ דברים מַזְכִּירִים וכ׳</he> three occasions cause the sins of man to be remembered; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cite (as an argument), to take into account. Ib. 60ᵃ; a. e. אין מזכירין מ״נ miracles must not be cited as evidence.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 40b:3">Kidd. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>אין מזכירין לו שוב רשעו</he> his wickedness is not counted; a. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:5">Ber. I, 5</cite> <he>מזכירין י״מ וכ׳</he> we must recite the going out from Egypt (<cite ref="Numbers 15:37">Num. XV, 37</cite> to 41) in night prayers; a. fr.
